articles.title: Ether and XRP ETFs post outflows as bitcoin moves above $77,000
articles.snippet: Ether funds shed money for a third straight session even as the token rose, while every major gained and zcash extended its run.

articles.title: Real stocks are finally coming on blockchain. Here’s how the SEC wants it to work
articles.snippet: The SEC is giving tokenized stocks a regulated U.S. pathway, while keeping trading volumes, access and issuer rights tightly controlled.

articles.title: The Ondo Finance succession crisis gets messier as Kathleen Allman’s daughter alleges ‘dementia’, alcoholism and reckless spending
articles.snippet: The estranged daughter of 77-year-old Kathleen Allman has petitioned a Hawaiian court to establish a limited conservatorship to protect her parents’ share of her brother’s stake in Ondo.

articles.title: Kevin O’Leary says Congress will revisit Clarity early next year as crypto tax bill advances
articles.snippet: The Shark Tank investor says Congress will face pressure to revive crypto market structure legislation as it moves to establish tax rules for digital assets.

articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.snippet: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.
